(1) turnover research has progressed in terms of the predictors examined, but not in terms of the theories used to examine those predictors; and (2) the most pressing needs of future turnover research are to: (2a) develop new theories of turnover that are more integrative, (2b) consider the role of the organization and its environment in turnover research, and (2c) consider the role and influence of the individual's personal context in turnover research.
